hooks.text: 二十多种单位、七十七项升级、四个被动和五种特技支撑大规模多线防守
hooks.excerpt: NETD deploys you in big battles of +20 different units, +77 unique upgrades, 4 passive powers, and 5 special abilities.

hooks.text: 从海滩登陆到沙漠壕沟，不同战场地形持续改写每轮部署体验
hooks.excerpt: From beach landings to desert trenches, Northend Tower Defense's rich level design allows players to continually gain unique gameplay experiences each round.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 僵尸模式加入新陷阱与空投，十二种四级强化可逐步电击、灼烧和爆破尸潮
hooks.excerpt: Deploy a variety of newly designed traps and pick up powerful airdrops, and face off against massive zombie hordes with your army. There are over 12 new powerful upgrades at your disposal. Each upgrade features 4 different levels, allowing you to shock, burn, electrify, and blow up your enemies in increasingly devastating ways.
